suggested_solution: Check Graphics Settings > Quality > Upscaling and set it to “Normal” if not already set.
Disable AMD FSR 1.0, as it may be causing issues with image quality.
Ensure the screen refresh rate under Options > Display is set to the monitor's optimal refresh rate setting (and correct display resolution).
Check the gamma slider in Options > Graphics > Gamma and adjust for your monitor situation.
Clear out the shader cache (C:\Users\[USER]\AppData\Local\nVIDIA\DXCache) and ensure it has a sufficient capacity.
